what: Known section-detection defects of the parser as of 2026-11-17: filings in the 150-filing blast-radius sample that miss a required item (1, 1A, 7, 7A, 8). tests/unit/parsing/test_known_defects.py asserts each expected_found item with strict xfail, so a parser fix makes the test XPASS and fails until the marker is removed. Items in needs_gold_label are not asserted: nobody has shown where they start.
how_to_run: the filings are cached by `python -m eval.blast_radius` under data/fixture_candidates/blast/; the test skips when a filing is not cached
